translations.web: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
translations.bsb: He who ignores discipline despises himself, but whoever heeds correction gains understanding.
translations.kjv: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
translations.asv: He that refuseth correction despiseth his own soul; But he that hearkeneth to reproof getteth understanding.
